prompts.title: Reflected operator subclass priority
prompts.description: A subclass overriding __radd__ is tried before the base's __add__, then NotImplemented falls back.

messages.content:
Determine exactly what this self-contained Python 3 program prints. Reply with exactly one line: ANSWER: <output>. No explanation, Markdown, or other text.

```
order = []

class A:
    def __add__(self, o):
        order.append("A.add")
        return NotImplemented
    def __radd__(self, o):
        order.append("A.radd")
        return "ar"

class B(A):
    def __radd__(self, o):
        order.append("B.radd")
        return "br"

a, b = A(), B()
r1 = a + b
r2 = b + a
print(r1, r2, ",".join(order))
```

prompts.title: ExitStack unwinding with selective suppression
prompts.description: Inner manager re-raises, outer swallows; the exception never reaches the surrounding except.

messages.content:
Determine exactly what this self-contained Python 3 program prints. Reply with exactly one line: ANSWER: <output>. No explanation, Markdown, or other text.

```
import contextlib

log = []

@contextlib.contextmanager
def cm(name, swallow=False):
    log.append("enter:" + name)
    try:
        yield name
    except ValueError:
        log.append("swallow:" + name)
        if not swallow:
            raise
    finally:
        log.append("exit:" + name)

try:
    with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
        stack.enter_context(cm("outer", swallow=True))
        stack.enter_context(cm("inner"))
        raise ValueError("boom")
except ValueError:
    log.append("escaped")
print(",".join(log))
```

prompts.title: groupby group invalidation and tee buffering
prompts.description: Materializing groupby's groups after the fact yields empty groups; tee buffers rather than sharing.

messages.content:
Determine exactly what this self-contained Python 3 program prints. Reply with exactly one line: ANSWER: <output>. No explanation, Markdown, or other text.

```
import itertools

data = [1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 1, 1]
stale = [(k, list(g)) for k, g in list(itertools.groupby(data))]
fresh = [(k, len(list(g))) for k, g in itertools.groupby(data)]
t1, t2 = itertools.tee(iter(data))
next(t1)
head = list(itertools.islice(t2, 3))
print(stale, fresh, head, len(list(t1)))
```

prompts.title: Short SLRU trace with promotion and demotion
prompts.description: Compact variant of Master: Segmented LRU over a long access trace.

messages.content:
An initially empty SLRU cache has probation and protected segments, each capacity 2.
Miss: append to probation MRU, evict probation LRU on overflow.
Probation hit: move to protected MRU; if protected overflows, demote its LRU to probation MRU, then evict probation LRU if necessary.
Protected hit: move to protected MRU. Every hit increments the hit count.
Process left to right: A B A C B A D A C B E A B C D E A B A
Return hits and final probation/protected arrays, each in LRU-to-MRU order.

Return exactly one raw JSON object with only these fields: hits (integer), probation (array), protected (array). Follow the stated array order. No explanation or Markdown.
